scope: e05 language-neutral tool integration contract research

user_decision.question: What should tool authors integrate with first?
user_decision.meaning: A small versioned local message contract usable from Python, Rust, JS or another language; tool authors do not implement ACP. Reuse the established broker internally rather than a second ownership arbiter.

installed_OMP.environment: cleared; private HOME/cwd; no ambient auth/config

consumer_findings.evidence: SDK createAgentSession(options) returns session; SessionManager.inMemory(), session.subscribe(), prompt(), abort(), beginDispose()/dispose() are documented
createAgentSession interactivePrompts:true plus setToolUIContext(uiContext,true); typed askDialog/select/editor callbacks

tools/approval.ts requestApproval invokes ui.approve when supplied; types.ts returns once/session/deny or an offered grant; initializeExtensions(session,{uiContext,...}) installs the extension runner UI
ExtensionApprovalPrompt grants explicitly permits hosts that omit remembered choices to answer once/session/deny; initial adapter will advertise only once/deny and return actual once/deny values

consumer_findings.capability: plain RPC as full permission adapter
consumer_findings.evidence: RPC UI has no typed approve implementation, so requestApproval falls back to generic select; generic menu text is not an authoritative permission discriminator
integrations/omp/amux.ts and lifecycle.ts report lifecycle only; no responder or input fence
docs/sdk.md startup section documents model-origin connection prewarm; disposal source also mentions paid warming; initialization alone must not be treated as an offline smoke

broker_findings.authority: src/control.rs:1194-1213 locks target, checks authority and commits before releasing; no child I/O in transaction
broker_findings.closed_routing: src/daemon.rs:1237-1268 separates ACP and native operations; new target kind must not become native PTY input
broker_findings.launch: src/acp.rs:540-605 reserves target;1350-1455 owns child and captured ProcessTree and retains original endpoints
broker_findings.forms: src/acp.rs:2113-2170 validates exactly one session/request scope and an actually outstanding parent request
broker_findings.permissions: src/acp.rs:2173-2211 preserves exact offered IDs and four supported allow/reject once/always kinds
broker_findings.view: src/tui/agent.rs uses canonical target/control/generation binding and bounded interaction/history; reuse this editor instead of duplicating it
broker_findings.reuse_recommendation: An in-process concrete ToolV1 codec in the existing structured broker, not a second daemon arbiter or an extra bridge child. One daemon-owned tool integration child retains existing endpoint/worker/process cleanup observability. Preserve ACP wire/API behavior unchanged.
broker_findings.LSP: Ready rust-analyzer returned no references for the known cross-worktree Broker symbol. Tool issue reported; direct source-observed callers above are not a complete fan-out count. Repair workspace navigation before symbol migration during Build.
